rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Connects AI assistants to a self-hosted Rerun session replay collector, providing four tools for listing replays, retrieving summaries, generating narrative descriptions of user sessions, and analyzing friction patterns like rage clicks and broken flows. Users self-host the Rerun collector (locally, on Cloud Run, or backed by S3/GCS) and authenticate the MCP server with a read key. Built by Mimetic Inc, the company behind the Rerun open-source session replay tool.
